headlines.title: Trump and Obama rally supporters in key battleground states ahead of midterms
headlines.description: President Trump and former President Obama both took to Michigan this weekend to rally supporters in the key battleground state ahead of midterms. NBC News’ Shaquille Brewster reports from Michigan.

headlines.title: Alaska Senate candidate Mary Peltola delays campaign events after car crash
headlines.description: Anchorage police confirmed a crash involving three vehicles occurred Saturday and said those involved sustained “non-life threatening” injuries.

headlines.title: Send your questions for Steve Kornacki on the midterm elections
headlines.description: Election Day is quickly approaching and, with just over a week to go, Steve Kornacki is ready to answer your questions.

headlines.title: Brazilian President Lula wins a historic fourth term
headlines.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva was re-elected for a historic fourth term in office. Lula’s far-right opponent Flavio Bolsonaro refused to concede and called for the results to be annulled after a Supreme Court ruling extended the voting by two hours.

headlines.title: Israelis Set to Vote in First Election Since Oct. 7 Attacks
headlines.description: Israelis will get the opportunity to vote whether to keep Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu or replace him in the first election since the Oct. 7 attacks in 2023. New polls show Netanyahu is in a tight race with former Israeli Army Chief of Staff Gadi Eisenkot. NBC's Richard Engel reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Police arrest a 15-year-old in shooting near Florida A&M stadium that injured 12
headlines.description: A 15-year-old male has been arrested in connection with a shooting close to Florida A&M University’s Bragg Memorial Stadium over the weekend that injured 12 people, according to police.

headlines.title: NFL Week 7: A divisional duel in Detroit, and Aaron Rodgers keeps winning
headlines.description: Week 7 of the NFL season featured a Super Bowl contender getting back on track and a thrilling divisional showdown in the NFC North, plus another comeback win for one of the NFL’s most surprising teams.

headlines.title: Debbie Shields speaks out on her viral moment riffing with Conan O'Brien
headlines.description: Internet sensation Debbie Shields speaks with NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian about her recent viral video, where she stood out during an improvised conversation with Conan O'Brien on the popular internet talk show “Subway Takes.”

headlines.title: Eric Bauza, voice of Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and Porky Pig, dies at 46
headlines.description: Eric Bauza, best known for voicing the lovable “Looney Tunes” characters Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and Porky Pig, has died, his family said Monday.

headlines.title: What to know about the Israeli elections as Netanyahu faces a battle for survival
headlines.description: After three years of navigating war, crisis and global outcry, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is facing one of the most significant electoral tests of his decades-long political career.
